name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the return of Ukrainian children forcibly transferred and deported by Russia
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Russia to stop transferring and deporting Ukrainian children and to say where every child is. It wants Russia to let aid groups reach them and to return them safely. It asks the European Union to punish people involved in these crimes and to help Ukraine find missing children. It says any real peace deal must include bringing these children home and holding those responsible to account. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- The Parliament asks Russia to report where deported Ukrainian children are and return them.
- It asks the European Union to sanction those responsible and support efforts to find missing children.
- It calls for these children's return to be part of any peace deal; no law changes.
